Empires & Puzzles Matrera Review: The Ice Cold Executioner

Matrera isn't just a sniper; she's an efficiency expert. With her unique ability to spill excess damage onto neighbors, she solves the age-old problem of 'overkilling' a weak target. But in a world of 1300+ Attack stats, does her gargoyle stone skin still hold up? We break down the numbers.
Matrera Review: The Sniper Who Never Wastes a Drop (of Damage)
Matrera: The Sniper Who Treats Damage Like a Buffet (No Leftovers Allowed)

Matrera arrived in late 2022 as part of the Sanctuary of Gargoyles family, bringing a refreshing twist to the classic sniper archetype. A 5-star Ice Legendary with the Rogue class, she was designed to solve one of the most frustrating aspects of high-damage single-target heroes: the dreaded Overkill. While most snipers waste 5000 damage hitting a hero with 10 HP left, Matrera efficiently recycles that violence for the neighbors. She's a "Green" hero in spirit—very eco-friendly with her damage distribution.

Matrera sports a classic gargoyle aesthetic—stone-grey skin, horns that would make a demon jealous, and wings that look heavy enough to crush a sedan. Her visual design fits perfectly with the gothic, brooding atmosphere of the Gargoyle family. She looks like she spends her weekends perched on Notre Dame judging tourists, which, let's be honest, is a vibe we can all appreciate.

This is her crown jewel. If you target an enemy with low health, the "excess" damage isn't lost—it hits the neighbors. This transforms her from a Sniper into a pseudo-AoE (Area of Effect) finisher. It removes the tactical hesitation of "should I use my sniper to finish this 5% HP tank?"
The -40% attack down for 4 turns to the target and neighbors is a substantial defensive layer, often neutering the enemy's retaliation.

If you pull Matrera early, she is a game-changer. Her Stoneskin will let her survive bosses that should one-shot her, and her damage will delete enemies in map stages. Level her immediately.

She is a luxury toy. If you have her maxed from 2023, she still has use in War depth. Is she worth Alpha Aethers today? Probably not, unless you really love the art or lack a strong Blue sniper. There are harder hitters who move faster.
The community reaction to Matrera was generally positive but measured.
Many players initially compared her to Demona, noting the similarities in trying to fix the "sniper overkill" issue.

A common complaint was her speed. "She is too slow to be a sniper," one user noted. However, defenders argued, "If you can work with the conditional... she can potentially knock out 3 in one fell swoop."
Interestingly, many players felt the 4-star Gargoyle, Bellerive, stole her thunder by offering a similar mechanic at a cheaper investment cost.

Matrera is like a high-quality Swiss Army Knife in a toolbox full of power drills. She might not have the raw horsepower of the newest Construct or Astral heroes, but her elegance and efficiency are undeniable. Her ability to turn a "wasteful" kill shot into a "tactical nuke" on the neighbors is one of the most satisfying feelings in Empires & Puzzles.
A solid B+ hero in the modern era. Keep her for cleanups and tournaments, but maybe don't bet the farm on her in the top 100.
